verdict.rationale: The CLI docs say you can connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription and use its models for local reviews, so a developer can pick between OpenAI and Anthropic models. This choice applies only to local CLI reviews. Ultrareview switches to "cubic's most capable review models", which is a review-depth mode rather than a user-chosen model. Missing for 10: model or provider selection for GitHub PR reviews and chat, explicit per-model picking within a provider, providers beyond the two subscriptions, and independent corroboration.
